categories.main_business_segments: Chenguang Biotech Group primarily operates in the natural plant extraction industry, focusing on six main product series: natural pigments, natural spice extracts and essential oils, natural nutrition and medicinal extracts, natural sweeteners, health foods, and oils and proteins. The company also engages in cottonseed-related businesses including processing and sales of cottonseed products. Additionally, it has subsidiaries involved in agricultural planting and pharmaceutical production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced extraction technologies such as ultrasonic extraction, low-temperature extraction, crystallization and chromatography separation, supercritical CO2 extraction, subcritical extraction, and microencapsulation. It has developed proprietary equipment tailored to its production processes, enabling high yield and cost efficiency. The R&D approach follows a 'small test + pilot test + scale-up + industrial production' model, emphasizing continuous innovation and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chenguang Biotech serves downstream industries including food and beverage, seasoning, pharmaceuticals, health supplements, cosmetics, and animal feed additives. Its products are widely used in these sectors domestically and internationally. Key customers include well-known enterprises in these industries, with a sales network covering Europe, Asia, Southeast Asia, Americas, Oceania, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases and sales networks nationwide. It has established raw material planting bases and subsidiaries in regions such as Xinjiang, Yunnan, India, Zambia, Myanmar, and the United States. Overseas subsidiaries handle planting, processing, and sales activities, supporting global resource integration and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chenguang Biotech operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on extraction and processing of plant-based raw materials into intermediate and finished products. It also extends upstream by managing raw material planting bases and downstream by developing formulated health products and pharmaceuticals, thus covering a broad vertical integration within the natural plant extraction and health product industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment to enhance product yields, quality, and develop new products. It aims to build a portfolio of around ten world-leading products, focusing on core items like chili red pigment, chili oleoresin, and lutein. R&D efforts include process improvements, new product development, efficacy research, and resource utilization. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and AI integration to boost efficiency and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of natural plant extracts, health foods, oils, proteins, and cottonseed-related products. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors and agents, covering domestic and international markets. Online direct sales exist but currently contribute less than 0.5% of total revenue. Revenue recognition follows delivery and customer acceptance based on contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chenguang Biotech is the largest listed company in China's plant extraction industry and ranks among the global leaders. It competes with international companies like Frutarom, Kalsec, Synthite, and Lycored. The company holds world-leading or top positions in key products such as chili red pigment, chili oleoresin, and lutein, and is rapidly expanding its portfolio of leading products, leveraging scale, technology, and brand advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 6.99 billion, a 1.79% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 94 million, down 80.39% due to commodity price fluctuations impacting cottonseed business profitability. The company maintains total assets of over RMB 9 billion and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion despite short-term profit pressure. It has a stable cash flow and sound financial position with ongoing strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chenguang Biotech emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective, and stable supply of natural plant extracts with advanced proprietary technologies and industrial-scale production. Its products offer natural, safe, and health-promoting attributes, meeting growing consumer demand for clean-label and natural ingredients. The company’s integrated supply chain, strong R&D capabilities, and broad product portfolio provide differentiated value and competitive advantages in global markets.
